claims: As of April 12, 2026, Rory McIlroy has won six major championships.
Rory McIlroy has achieved a career Grand Slam.
Rory McIlroy won back-to-back Masters titles in 2025 and 2026.
Rory McIlroy won the 2011 U.S. Open at Congressional Country Club with an 8-stroke victory.
Rory McIlroy won the 2012 PGA Championship at Kiawah Island Club with an 8-stroke victory.
Rory McIlroy won the 2014 Open Championship at Royal Liverpool Golf Club.
Rory McIlroy won the 2014 PGA Championship at Valhalla Golf Club.
Rory McIlroy won the 2025 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club.
Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club.
Rory McIlroy is only the sixth man to win all four major tournaments in his career.
Rory McIlroy had a ten-year drought in major championships prior to his 2025 Masters win.
Rory McIlroy's 2025 Masters win completed his career Grand Slam.
A 58s YouTube video titled 'Rory McIlroy reflects on his 2025 Masters victory' by PGA TOUR was published on Apr 6, 2026.
